test_cases.name: r2_partner_email_with_example_profile
test_cases.input: Using the example profile in examples/example-profile.md, rewrite as an email to a partner: I hope this email finds you well. I am pleased to inform you that we can leverage our voucher program. However, it is crucial to highlight that participants must enter credit card details. Best regards.
assertions: Opens with 'Hi [Name],', not 'I hope this email finds you well'
Puts the decision on the first line and lists the risk as a short bullet
Ends with a direct question with a date, then 'Cheers,' and 'Sam' on its own line

test_cases.name: no_profile_falls_back_to_template

Says no personal profile was found and points to the template or human-voice
